hooks.name: Auto Lint & Format on Save (Senior Standard)
hooks.description: Detecta a stack do projeto e aplica linter/formatter apropriado ao salvar arquivos de código. Prioriza qualidade e consistência automáticas, sem intervenção manual. Falha silenciosa se a ferramenta não estiver instalada, para nunca bloquear o fluxo.

action.command: FILE="$KIRO_FILE_PATH"; DIR="$(dirname "$FILE")"; ROOT="$(git -C "$DIR" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo "$DIR")"; cd "$ROOT" || exit 0; case "$FILE" in *.js|*.jsx|*.ts|*.tsx|*.mjs|*.cjs) if [ -f package.json ] && npx --no-install prettier -v >/dev/null 2>&1; then npx --no-install prettier --write "$FILE" >/dev/null 2>&1; fi; if [ -f package.json ] && npx --no-install eslint -v >/dev/null 2>&1; then npx --no-install eslint --fix "$FILE" >/dev/null 2>&1; fi ;; *.py) if command -v ruff >/dev/null 2>&1; then ruff format "$FILE" >/dev/null 2>&1; ruff check --fix "$FILE" >/dev/null 2>&1; elif command -v black >/dev/null 2>&1; then black "$FILE" >/dev/null 2>&1; fi ;; *.go) if command -v gofmt >/dev/null 2>&1; then gofmt -w "$FILE" >/dev/null 2>&1; fi ;; *.rs) if command -v rustfmt >/dev/null 2>&1; then rustfmt "$FILE" >/dev/null 2>&1; fi ;; *.rb) if command -v rubocop >/dev/null 2>&1; then rubocop -A "$FILE" >/dev/null 2>&1; fi ;; *.json|*.css|*.scss|*.md|*.yaml|*.yml) if npx --no-install prettier -v >/dev/null 2>&1; then npx --no-install prettier --write "$FILE" >/dev/null 2>&1; fi ;; esac; exit 0
